title: The Latest Circular Wins, and the Dataset Says Which One It Is
description: เจ้าของงานตัดสินว่าหนังสือเวียนกรมบัญชีกลางต้องใช้ฉบับล่าสุดเสมอ ทั้งบัญชีค่าแรงงานและตาราง Factor F กฎนี้ถูกบันทึกลง docs/rules/engineering.md และเปลี่ยนงานที่ค้างอยู่: การตามหาตาราง 6% ฉบับก่อน ว481 ไม่ใช่เงื่อนไขของการคำนวณอีกต่อไป สิ่งที่ต้องมีแทนคือกลไกที่บอกได้ว่าฉบับที่ระบบถืออยู่ยังเป็นฉบับล่าสุดหรือไม่ พร้อมกันนั้นบันทึกว่า ว480 บัญชีค่าแรงชุดใหม่ออกวันเดียวกับ ว481 และแทน ว809 ที่เอกสารเดิมอ้างไว้
scope: record the rule that reference values come from the latest Comptroller General circular, with the superseded pair named
require every reference dataset to carry issuer, document number, date, the criteria it acts under and a file checksum, and to declare when no qualified person has certified it
replace the search for the pre-ว481 6% table with a check that the held circular is still the current one
note that ว480 replaces ว809 as the labour rate source, seven months newer
verification: docs/rules/engineering.md carries the rule and names ว480 and ว481 as current, superseding ว809 and ว499
docs/research/factor-f-provenance-2026-08-24.md carries both circulars, the timeline from 2565 to 2569 and the two questions still open
node scripts/check-roadmap.mjs passes with the pointer matching the versioned file
pushed and tagged v0.23.0-latest-circular-rule; the Quality Gate passed on the commit that carries it
rollback: Revert the v0.23.0 commit. Documentation and plan only; no code, schema or dataset changes.
constraints: ว481 is not the circular that moved the rate from 7% to 6%: it reissued the tables in a new format under criteria effective 9 June 2569. The circular that changed the rate is still unidentified, and under the latest-wins rule it no longer blocks pricing.
Pricing a project retrospectively against the circular in force on its own pricing date is a separate question from which circular the product uses today, and is not decided here.

items.title: Record the latest-circular rule and make every reference dataset carry its issuer, number, date, criteria and checksum
Give the product a way to tell that the Factor F and labour circulars it holds are still the current ones
Bring the ว480 labour rate schedule in as a dataset, keeping the conditions that change a rate (quantity bands, area, method) as data rather than notes
Decide whether a cost of work between two printed rows interpolates or takes the lower row, and record the decision with the authority for it
Have a qualified person certify the Factor F dataset and record the name, so pricing can require a reviewed table
